text:
maria: Heads-up — customer reported SSE sessions that cut off mid-response, then client reconnects and we see duplicate token usage billed. They repro'd consistently on their 10s idle timeout.

jake: Can you paste the minimal repro + logs?

maria: Repro steps below. Happens with our hosted API behind ALB. Short log excerpt: 
```
2026-03-12T15:22:08.123Z INFO stream:start session_id=xyz123 client_ip=1.2.3.4
2026-03-12T15:22:18.456Z WARN stream:stalled session_id=xyz123 last_evt_id=evt-45
2026-03-12T15:22:19.002Z INFO connection:close session_id=xyz123 reason=idle-timeout
2026-03-12T15:22:19.350Z INFO stream:resume session_id=xyz123 client_reconnect=true last_evt_id=evt-45
2026-03-12T15:22:19.355Z INFO billing:tokens_charged session_id=xyz123 tokens=120 request_id=req-9
```

mila: Are they using Last-Event-ID or manual resume? client lib?

maria: They send `Last-Event-ID: evt-45` on reconnect. Client is a custom JS lib that retries immediately (no backoff).

liu: Two likely things: (1) ALB or intermediate proxy is tearing TCP because it thinks connection idle; SSE comment pings may not be sufficient for upstream idle timers. (2) Our resumable logic double-applies tokens when session resumes if the original stream was truncated early.

tony: ALB default idle is 60s (or 350s depending on config). But many customers front with proxies/nginx with aggressive 10s idle. Important to differentiate: TCP keepalive is below HTTP layer — it won't keep HTTP/1.1 streaming alive unless it prevents socket teardown. Comment pings (":
: 
") are application-level events that some proxies ignore as not activity.

jake: Can we capture a pcap or netstat on their ip to see FIN/RESET?

maria: Customer provided tcpdump showing RST from their gateway right after a 10s gap. So we think gateway kills idle TCP.

mila: Client reconnect pattern matters — immediate reconnect + no idempotency = server replays tokens or charges again. Suggest client include `x-session-resume: <session-id>` and server de-dupes by `session_id + last_evt_id`.

liu: Agreed. Proposed server-side mitigations: 1) hold a short grace window (e.g., 2s) before charging tokens on abrupt stream close; 2) make resume idempotent by recording resume markers per `request_id` or `session_id`+`last_evt_id`.

tony: Operational: add an observability metric that tags stream closes by TCP close type (FIN vs RST) and which hop closed it. Also surface ALB/edge timeouts in Console for Hosted customers.

maria: For immediate customer unblock, suggested steps given to them:
1) patch client to jitter/backoff reconnects (100-500ms) and send `Last-Event-ID`.
2) enable TCP keepalive on client (OS/net stack) and set keepalive interval < gateway idle.
3) if they control proxy, increase proxy idle timeout or accept comment pings.

jake: Any changes we need server-side right now?

liu: Short-term hotfix we can deploy to Hosted: when a stream closes with `abrupt=true` and we see a reconnect within 1s with `Last-Event-ID`, don't double-charge tokens for events <= last_evt_id. That's pure server-side dedupe and low-risk.

maria: I can file a small rollout for that rule. Also adding a debug header to responses: `x-rl-stream-status: <state>` so clients can confirm session state during reconnects.

devbot: (deploy-bot) 2239876600: created branch `hotfix/sse-dedupe-preresume` by liu, PR: https://git.redwood/infer/pull/4321

tony: For long-term: we should document our recommended keepalive strategy in Support KB — compare approaches: TCP keepalive, ALB idle config, comment-pings, and graceful-charge windows.

mila: Also note some browser environments (Cloudflare Workers, mobile NATs) will treat comment pings poorly. We should call out platform quirks.

jake: For billing concerns, support ticket owner should ask for the request_ids of the duplicate charges. We can zero-credit if server dedupe can't reconcile.

maria: I'll share repro bundle (client trace + tcpdump + our server traces) with Eng on the PR comment.

liu: Action items:
- liu: implement server-side resume dedupe rule (hotfix PR already created).
- maria: send repro bundle + request_ids to billing & eng.
- tony: add stream-close-by-hop metric to telemetry backlog.
- mila: add KB draft for keepalive recommendations.

maria: Thanks — moving to escalate->eng if hotfix passes QA. :thumbsup:

tony: :eyes:

jake: Good plan.

maria: (closing note) customer will hold until EOD tomorrow for hotfix verification.
